criteria.statement: Private Gitea migration uses service=git plus auth_username/auth_password, keeps clone_addr credential-free, and no longer receives the former provider-mismatch 422.
GitHub migration remains service=github with auth_token and derived github.com clone URL behavior.
Missing, unsupported, or incomplete source-provider configuration fails before credential resolution or external side effects.
Exact replay remains idempotent and an invalid, non-mirror, empty-source, or mismatched-source existing repository fails closed.
HTTPS and credential-free clone URL enforcement remains active, and returned errors or logs contain no source or fleet credential.
